title: Juicy Drop
game_overview: A cozy physics puzzle game where players drop and merge fruits inside a wooden jar to evolve giant watermelons.
winning_condition: Merge two giant watermelons to achieve the ultimate celebratory explosion and maximum high score.
losing_condition: Fruits remain stacked above the upper danger line continuously for 2.5 seconds.

controls.action: Position the held fruit horizontally along the top drop line.
Release and drop the active fruit into the container.
Toggle audio synthesis sound effects on or off.
Restart the game session and clear the container.

sections.title: Design Pillars
sections.content: 1. Tactile Physics Delight: Bouncy, soft, satisfying rigid-body collisions. 2. Cozy Kawaii Aesthetic: Warm pastel palette, expressive fruit faces, and pleasant chime audio. 3. Spatial Strategy: Managing container volume and anticipating chain-reaction fruit fusions.

sections.title: Core Loop
sections.content: Aim droppable fruit -> Release into physics jar -> Collide identical fruit tiers -> Merge into next tier with particle burst and score chimes -> Avoid overflowing past the danger line -> Beat personal high score.

sections.title: Core Mechanics
sections.content: 1. 11-Tier Fruit Evolution: Merging identical fruits destroys both and creates the next tier fruit at the midpoint with an elastic pop animation. 2. Random Dropper Pool: The dropper spawns only Tiers 1 through 5 (Cherry, Strawberry, Grape, Dekopon, Persimmon). 3. 500ms Drop Cooldown: Prevents rapid-fire dropping and accidental overlaps. 4. Danger Line Detection: A horizontal threshold checks settled fruits (>2s age); exceeding it continuously for 2.5s triggers Game Over.
sections.summary: Key interactive systems and physics rules.

sections.title: Movement & Scrolling Alignment
sections.content: Scrolling Axis: Static single-screen container. Asset Orientation: Dropper moves horizontally at fixed Y; fruits fall vertically under 2D gravity. Physics Kinetics: Matter.js engine with restitution 0.2, friction 0.1, density scaling, and angular velocity.

sections.title: Visual Hierarchy & Layering
sections.content: Background Layer: Creamy pastel backdrop (#FDF6E3) with subtle wooden borders (#D4A373). Playfield Layer: Translucent glass-like container containing high-contrast vibrant fruits with kawaii faces that rotate with body angle. Overlay Layer: Dashed drop guide, danger line (flashing red when breached), floating score popups, Next Fruit badge, and Game Over modal.
sections.summary: Clear visual planes and hazard affordance.

sections.title: Fairness Tools
sections.content: 1. Next Fruit Preview badge. 2. Dashed vertical drop guideline clamped to container boundaries. 3. Evolution wheel/legend displaying all 11 fruit tiers in order. 4. Grace timer on danger line so bouncing fruits don't cause instant false defeats.
sections.summary: Assistance and visual cues for the player.

sections.title: Juice & Game Feel
sections.content: Anticipation Juice: Fruit follows pointer with smooth horizontal interpolation and dashed guide. State Change Juice: Elastic scale-in spawn animation, floating +Score texts, and sparkling confetti particles. Impact Juice: Pitch-ascending Web Audio chimes on higher merges, celebratory fireworks on dual Watermelon fusions.

sections.title: Virtual Touch Controls Implementation
sections.content: Direct canvas touch drag and release tracking with touch-action: none. Responsive container scaling that fits mobile portrait viewports with comfortable touch margins.
sections.summary: Responsive touch controls for mobile screens.
